summary: Audio playback and microphone recording work through an audio service with an SDK client, and the shell has a V4L2 camera pipeline for the Camera app. Apps get no camera capture API, no capture session model, no photo or depth capture, no audio engine graph and no speech synthesis.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/capture_session.rs (CaptureSession); springboard/ui/src/video_device.rs (select_device, plan_stream); springboard/src/media/v4l2.rs (probe, Device::open, format enumeration); wired: springboard/src/shell/camera/mod.rs; springboard/src/shell/camera/devices.rs (camera_ids)
features.note: CaptureSession models one usable video input, the frame size, the plan made on start and the lock while running, tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-os-09.rs. Gap: no app can open a device, the Camera app runs its own V4L2 path, and there are no audio inputs or session outputs; verify on Midget.

PhotoSettings checks the format, JPEG quality, self-timer delay and square crop, tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-os-09.rs. Gap: no app-facing photo output takes a picture, and there are no EXIF, Live Photo or RAW settings; the Camera app does the capture

features.feature: Audio and video capture (movie files, sample buffers)
features.note: Microphone to WAV works via audiod; no video recording to file, no sample buffer outputs for apps, no preview layer API

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 2 (theme-33, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Only an in-app QR scanner; no depth, face or barcode metadata outputs, no synchronizer

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 10 tests. Wave 4 (w4-avfoundation-capture-audio, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Sandbox doc lists a portal for devices as future work; no per-app camera or microphone prompt
Queue, repeat, live streams, transport over a socket, client at bifrost_app::audio; used by Music and Podcasts. No AVAudioPlayer-style per-object players or pan/rate per player
Record start/stop to WAV through the audio service; no level metering API, no format settings, no AAC/ALAC recording round 75, host only: noise-gated copy of a take.

features.apple: AVAudioEngine, AVAudioNode, AVAudioUnit effects, AVAudioFile, AVAudioPCMBuffer
features.note: Wave 4 (theme-06, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. File decode and conversion helpers exist; no node graph, effects, mixer nodes or buffer API for apps

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/audio_session.rs (categories, activation, interruptions, route changes); springboard/sdk/src/audio_devices.rs (output route and volume events); springboard/src/media/route.rs, springboard/src/media/volume.rs, springboard/audio/alsa/src/ctl.rs
features.note: Apps declare a session category, activate it and receive interruption and route-change events in the audio_session model, with its rules tested inline. Gap: audiod does not yet arbitrate sessions, so the shell still routes the speaker and the ALSA mixer alone

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No text-to-speech engine or SDK API found in the repo; relevant for accessibility (VoiceOver counterpart) Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/audio_settings.rs (Settings, Format, Quality; to_map and from_map)
features.note: The settings dictionary keys (format, rate, channels, depth, quality, bitrate), per-format validation and the nearest supported configuration are tested in the model's own tests. Gap: nothing calls the model yet; the recorder in springboard/src/media/capture.rs still picks the first working PCM format and does not read a settings dictionary, and the audio server owns the device side.

gaps: App-facing capture API (session, device discovery, inputs and outputs) for camera and microphone
Per-app camera and microphone permission prompts
Audio engine graph with effects and buffers
Video recording to file and sample buffer outputs
Depth, metadata and synchronized multi-output capture
Recording settings, metering and compressed formats
